about.title: Westminster Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Westminster comes suddenly, the paperwork arrives before the grief has room to settle. Families in this Orange County city of about 92,000 face the same question after a preventable loss: what now? California gives certain relatives a civil path forward. A spouse or domestic partner and the children stand first; if none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify. The claim is separate from any criminal case and must generally be filed within two years of the date of death, with a shorter window when a public agency is involved. Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to the financial support the person would have provided and the love, companionship and guidance no one can replace. Public records show 82 injury collisions in Westminster during 2025, 112 people hurt and one traffic death, with the heaviest counts along Beach Boulevard (SR 39), Goldenwest Street and Westminster Boulevard. LawProactive connects your family, at no cost, with an independent attorney who handles these cases.

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can tell you where your family fits before you spend energy on the wrong path.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Is Real
items.desc: A wrongful death action must generally be filed within two years of the date of death, and the deadline shrinks when a government entity is involved. Connecting early keeps those options open.

items.title: The Full Picture of Loss
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. Attorneys in the network work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash happened on Beach Boulevard and police are still investigating. Do I have to wait?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death case is a civil matter, separate from any criminal investigation or prosecution, and it can move on its own track. Waiting for the criminal side to conclude does not pause California's two-year filing deadline, so it helps to speak with an attorney while the investigation continues.

items.question: My mother lived in Westminster and I supported her. Can I bring a claim?
items.answer: Possibly. California places a spouse or domestic partner and children first in line, and if none exist, certain dependents and heirs may have standing. Because eligibility turns on family structure and financial dependence, an attorney will want to look at your specific situation.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney; we are not a law firm and we do not charge for the connection. The attorneys in the network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.
